title: BeeBot agent record
description: Validates and documents runtime/agents/<agent_id>/record.json for an ordinary agent. One file per agent class, named for it: a class with a different record shape brings its own schema alongside this one, so adding it touches nothing here.

uuid.description: Lowercase hyphenated. agent_id is a v7 so a directory listing is a creation-order audit; session_id is whatever the backend minted and is opaque to everything but its adapter.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC, second resolution, always 'Z'. Fixed width on purpose: lexicographic order is then chronological, so these compare as plain strings.

type.description: Which class runs this agent, spelled exactly as the class is named -- so this record's own schema is assets/<type>.json. The outer key is the field; the inner one is JSON Schema's keyword. Pinned at creation, so editing a role's `type` later cannot change what an existing agent already is.

agent_id.description: The routing key, the chat address, and the lease all at once. Unguessable because knowing an address is the permission.

role.description: Names a directory under Configs/roles/. Deliberately separate from `type`: role selects a DIRECTORY and is configuration, type selects a CLASS and is code. Many roles may share one type.

instance.description: The persistent route name for an agent sharing one (source, cwd, role). Descriptive, not authoritative -- runtime/routes.jsonl decides routing and this only records its answer. Absent means the agent was created without a persistent instance; the reserved value 'fresh' is never recorded.

backend.description: Which adapter speaks for this agent. Read at creation from the role, then fixed -- a session cannot migrate between providers.

cwd.description: BeeBot state, not the provider's. A provider may adopt whatever directory it was last invoked from, so this is replayed on every call and never inferred back.

session_id.description: The whole of a stateless backend. Mortal: replaced after TTL expiry under a stable agent_id. Null only while the agent is dormant between sessions.

status.description: `prepared` is the create-versus-resume guard. `dormant` retains the stable agent without an attached backend session after TTL expiry.

session_since.description: When the current session began. Reset when a dormant agent wakes and null while it has no backend session.

session_turns.description: Model calls on the current session. Reset by refresh. The honest proxy for context growth if auto-compaction means a context-full error never arrives.

created.description: The agent's birth. Paired with session_since this is the whole agent-outlives-session idea: one is permanent, the other is replaced beneath it.

last_turn.description: Null until the first model call. A parked delivery is not a turn and does not stamp this.

turns.description: Model calls over the agent's whole life. One spin may make several, one per drain iteration.

cost_usd.description: Accumulated from what each call reported. Advisory: whether the provider's figure is per-turn or per-session is only weakly established.

timers.description: Optional wake timers owned by this agent. Missing means none have been created.
